questions.stem: Case 7301: Willow Company sells equipment that cost $9,600 and has accumulated depreciation of $250 for $2,400 cash. What gain or loss results? A positive amount is a gain.

reverses the sign of the gain or loss calculation

questions.stem: Case 7302: Willow Works acquires a patent for $9,250 with a ten-year useful life and no residual value. What is annual amortization expense?
